body.title: IMP-01 — Configure Inspection Reference Lists
body.description:
Task ID:
IMP-01

Category:
Reference lists and permissions

Objective:
Provide the approved inspection source, result and follow-up values with controlled maintenance access.

Detailed scope:
Create Inspection Source, Response Outcome, Inspection Outcome and Inspection Classification in the Inspections module. Add Code, Name, Active? and Sort to each object; populate the fourteen entries listed in this task. Configure ordinary users to read the lists, authorized program administrators to maintain them. The object names, settings, fields, entries and access rules are included below.

Required configuration:
Inspection Source
Create independent object Insp_InspectionSourceObject, display name Inspection Source, in Inspections; no inheritance.

Response Outcome
Create independent object Insp_ResponseOutcomeObject, display name Response Outcome, in Inspections; no inheritance.

Inspection Outcome
Create independent object Insp_OutcomeObject, display name Inspection Outcome, in Inspections; no inheritance.

Inspection Classification
Create independent object Insp_ClassificationObject, display name Inspection Classification, in Inspections; no inheritance.

Settings on all four objects
Set IsLocalizable=TRUE, IsAbstract=FALSE, HasWorkflow=FALSE, IsLocationBound=FALSE, IsSecurityEnabled=TRUE, IsAuditEnabled=FALSE and IsAttachmentEnabled=FALSE. Set DisplayProperty=Name and OrderProperty=Sort, ascending. Use native generated detail and inventory views.

Code — add to each object
Internal name Code; mandatory Text, maximum 100 characters, non-localizable, no default, unique within its object. Codes are stable once used by application rules; translated display names do not change codes.

Name — add to each object
Internal name Name; mandatory Text, maximum 255 characters, localizable, no default. Use as the displayed description.

Active? — add to each object
Internal name Active; mandatory Yes/No, default TRUE. FALSE makes a value unavailable for new user selections while existing references remain valid. Values required by automation remain active while that automation uses them.

Sort — add to each object
Internal name Sort; optional Float, no default. Use for ascending presentation order.

Inspection Source entry: INTERNAL
Create Code=INTERNAL; Name=Internal; Active=TRUE; Sort=10.

Inspection Source entry: EXTERNAL
Create Code=EXTERNAL; Name=External; Active=TRUE; Sort=20.

Response Outcome entry: UNANSWERED
Create Code=UNANSWERED; Name=Unanswered; Active=TRUE; Sort=10.

Response Outcome entry: NOT_APPLICABLE
Create Code=NOT_APPLICABLE; Name=Not applicable; Active=TRUE; Sort=20.

Response Outcome entry: INFORMATIONAL
Create Code=INFORMATIONAL; Name=Informational; Active=TRUE; Sort=30.

Response Outcome entry: NEGATIVE
Create Code=NEGATIVE; Name=Negative; Active=TRUE; Sort=40.

Response Outcome entry: POSITIVE
Create Code=POSITIVE; Name=Positive; Active=TRUE; Sort=50.

Inspection Outcome entry: NOT_ASSESSED
Create Code=NOT_ASSESSED; Name=Not assessed; Active=TRUE; Sort=10.

Inspection Outcome entry: PASS
Create Code=PASS; Name=Pass; Active=TRUE; Sort=20.

Inspection Outcome entry: NONCONFORMING
Create Code=NONCONFORMING; Name=Nonconforming; Active=TRUE; Sort=30.

Inspection Outcome entry: NOT_APPLICABLE
Create Code=NOT_APPLICABLE; Name=Not applicable; Active=TRUE; Sort=40.

Inspection Classification entry: IN_PROGRESS
Create Code=IN_PROGRESS; Name=In progress; Active=TRUE; Sort=10.

Inspection Classification entry: COMPLETE_OPEN_ACTIONS
Create Code=COMPLETE_OPEN_ACTIONS; Name=Complete with open actions; Active=TRUE; Sort=20.

Inspection Classification entry: COMPLETE_RESOLVED
Create Code=COMPLETE_RESOLVED; Name=Complete with all actions closed; Active=TRUE; Sort=30.

Ordinary application users — all four lists
Grant read access to entries required by the application. Grant no ordinary permission to create, change or delete reference-list records.

Authorized program administrators — all four lists
Grant maintenance access to Code, Name, Active? and Sort, subject to code stability and the active-value restrictions above. Bind this access to the supplied administrator groups.

Deliverable:
Four usable reference lists with their approved entries and permissions.

Strict technical prerequisites:
None

Blocked status:
Waiting for supplied inputs: G04 — Supply the actual authorized program-administrator groups for maintenance access to the four new reference lists. Only administrator permission bindings wait for these identities; object, field and entry creation can proceed.

Recommended implementer role:
Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant — product build manager (separate qualified reviewer)

Role rationale:
One configuration owner completes the related field, control and ordinary rule changes. Associate Consultant is the minimum role for the complete assignment; a separate Senior Consultant product build manager reviews it.

Acceptance criteria:
• Four independent objects exist in Inspections with the exact internal/display names, common object settings and four fields listed in this task.
• Each of the fourteen listed entries exists once within its own list with the stated Code, Name, Active=TRUE and Sort value.
• Code is mandatory, non-localizable and unique within each list; Name is mandatory/localizable; Active defaults TRUE; Sort is optional Float with no default.
• The native list views display Name and order entries by Sort ascending.
• Ordinary application users can read entries and cannot create, change or delete them.
• The supplied authorized administrator groups can maintain the lists within the stated code and active-value restrictions.

Specification references:
solution-specification.md — Inspection Source, Response Outcome, Inspection Outcome and Inspection Classification object tables and new reference-list access rules.

Assumptions and open questions:
Missing administrator-group identities affect maintenance permission bindings only. Initial inspection program and checklist records are owned by Data Migration.

Source plan:
Inspections — approved implementation plan; docs/phase 1/inspections/target/implementation-plan.md

Add the two Yes/No settings used to classify responses: Contributes to Outcome? on Question Abstract and Is Negative? on Choice. Extend the existing Published Question copy handler by one assignment so publication carries the contribution setting.

Task ID:

Category:

Objective:
Configure inspection sources, results, review routes and equipment settings through one consistent program setup.

Detailed scope:

Required configuration:
Source Mode

On Insp_Type_Detail (E1565) show an active-entry selector and require it for new/revised current programs. A legacy blank means Internal; prohibit changing source on a type already used by inspections.
